title: Common-level gluing of local finite etale covers on a normal tower
statement:
Let $p$ be a positive prime, let $V$ be a quasi-compact scheme, let $U\subseteq V$ be open, and let $P\to U$ be finite etale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. For each positive integer $m$ prime to $p$, let $X_m\to V$ be a Noetherian normal scheme over $V$, and for each $m\mid n$ let $q_{n,m}:X_n\to X_m$ be a $V$-morphism with $q_{m,m}=\mathrm{id}$ and $q_{n,m}q_{b,n}=q_{b,m}$ for $m\mid n\mid b$. Here Noetherian means locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and normal means that all local rings are integrally closed domains [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Put $U_m=X_m\times_V U$, and assume that $U_m$ contains the generic point of every irreducible component of $X_m$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-irreducible-components].
Suppose that for each $v\in V$ there are an open neighbourhood $W_v\subseteq V$, a positive integer $m_v$ prime to $p$, a finite etale scheme $Y_v\to X_{m_v}\times_V W_v$, and a specified isomorphism over $U_{m_v}\times_V W_v$
$$\theta_v:Y_v\times_{X_{m_v}}U_{m_v}\simeq P\times_U(U_{m_v}\times_V W_v).$$
Then there are finitely many points $v_1,\ldots,v_s$ with $V=\bigcup_jW_{v_j}$ and, for $n=\prod_{j=1}^s m_{v_j}$ (empty product $1$), a finite etale $Z\to X_n$ and an isomorphism
$$\theta:Z\times_{X_n}U_n\simeq P\times_U U_n.$$
More precisely, let $Z_j$ be the base change of $Y_{v_j}$ to $H_j=X_n\times_VW_{v_j}$ along $q_{n,m_{v_j}}$, and let $\theta_j$ be its induced identification with $P$ on $H_j\cap U_n$. On each overlap $H_i\cap H_j$ there is a unique isomorphism $\alpha_{ij}:Z_i|_{H_i\cap H_j}\simeq Z_j|_{H_i\cap H_j}$ whose restriction to $U_n$ is $\theta_j^{-1}\theta_i$. These isomorphisms satisfy $\alpha_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $\alpha_{jk}\alpha_{ij}=\alpha_{ik}$ on every triple overlap. There are isomorphisms $Z|_{H_j}\simeq Z_j$ inducing these $\alpha_{ij}$, and $\theta$ restricts to each specified $\theta_j$. Empty bases and covers are allowed. No assertion that integral closure commutes with the maps $q_{n,m}$ is required.

proof.text: By quasi-compactness [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], choose a finite subcover of the $W_v$ and enumerate its finite set by $\operatorname{Fin}(s)$. Take $n$ to be the product of the selected levels. Finset.prod_pos proves positivity, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff proves coprimality, and Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem proves divisibility of each selected level. The empty product gives $1$ without a separate nonemptiness assumption.

Apply [lem-sfb-normal-tower-overlap-system] to $A=X_n$, the selected opens, covers and identifications, and the tower maps $q_{n,m_j}$. Its normality and generic-point assumptions are precisely the given hypotheses specialized to $n$. It supplies only overlap isomorphisms and their uniqueness, identity and cocycle equations.

The selected opens cover $V$, so [lem-sfb-normal-tower-overlap-descent] realizes this particular overlap system. Assemble its global fields and the overlap fields in the unchanged Gluing constructor [def-sfb-normal-tower-cover-gluing-data], obtaining every clause of the conclusion.
